leads.claim: Documents claim the Pentagon recovered a crashed flying saucer and four alien bodies in 1947.
leads.why: The document explicitly references a specific claim of material recovery, though it identifies the source documents as fraudulent.
leads.claimant: Anonymous authors of purported Truman White House documents
leads.government_response: A group of scientists investigated the documents and declared them to be clumsy counterfeits.
leads.material_description: Crashed flying saucer and four alien creatures
leads.quote: Pentagon recovered a crashed flying saucer and the bodies of four alien creatures

doc_verdict: The document discusses claims of recovered material but explicitly dismisses the underlying evidence as fraudulent counterfeits.
